442324.findings: Framed thylacine head print in colour, Gould style plate with small caption 'Thylacinus cynocephalus' and tiny lithographer lines below the image. Colour and paper look like a modern facsimile of Gould's Mammals of Australia, not an original; cannot be confirmed from one photo.
442324.condition: Glazed in timber frame with gilt slip and buff mount; no visible damage.
442324.reason: Possible original Gould lithograph but looks like a reproduction; thylacine subject is collectable
442324.marks_read: Thylacinus cynocephalus; illegible tiny lithographer lines

442325.findings: Framed hand-coloured map 'Van Diemen's Land' with fine engraved border, colour wash along coast and small imprint line below that is too small to read. Style is 19th century atlas map (c.1840s-60s) though could be a later copy.
442325.condition: Glazed, gilt frame; no visible foxing in the photo.
442325.reason: Antique Tasmanian map, maker unread; possibly genuine 19th century

442326.findings: Sepia photograph mounted in dark mat, hand-lettered caption 'Loading apples at Hobart c. 1905'. Shows horse carts and steamship at wharf. Likely a modern reprint of a historic photo.

442328.condition: Heavy glazing reflections, toned paper; linen mount and gilt slip.
442328.reason: Old German thylacine plate, collectable subject
